title: Old Cinnabar Texture
description: Changes cinnabar back to what Minecraft LIVE showed it to be!
body:
If you thought cinnabar was cooler when it was revealed at Minecraft LIVE, you've found the right resource pack! This changes the base cinnabar block, but doesn't change the rest of the blockset.

26.2's Announcement
